question: Karisma has been spending ₹5,400 on the purchase of an item every year for the past three years. However, the price per unit of this item has fluctuated from year to year with the per unit price being ₹9 in the first year, ₹24 in the second year and ₹14.40 in the third year. What was the average per unit price that Karisma paid for this item in the three years?
solution:
Given:

Karisma has been spending ₹5,400 on the purchase of an item every year for the past three years.

She paid for the item in the first year, ₹24 in the second year and ₹14.40 in the third year. (per unit)

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

In the first year, she got 

⇒ 5400/9

⇒ 600 units of the item

In the second year, she got 

⇒ 5400/24

⇒ 225 units of the item

In the third year, she got 

⇒ 5400/14.4

⇒ 375 units of the item

Total units of item acquired by her = 600 + 225 + 375 = 1200 kg

Total price paid by her = 5400 × 3 = ₹16200

Now, the average per-unit price that she paid for this item in the three years

⇒ 16200/1200

⇒ ₹13.50

**∴ The average per-unit price that she paid for this item in the three years was ₹13.50.**
